title: Turcan Tuna Biography
summary: Turcan Tuna Ph.D. Candidate at Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich ETH Zurich, Robotic Systems Lab Biography Currently, I am a Ph.D. candidate at ETH Zurich , Robotic Systems Lab , where I work on robust spatial 3D perception and state estimation for robot autonomy in challenging real-world environments
content: Turcan Tuna Ph.D. Candidate at Robotic Systems Lab, ETH Zurich ETH Zurich, Robotic Systems Lab Biography Currently, I am a Ph.D. candidate at ETH Zurich , Robotic Systems Lab , where I work on robust spatial 3D perception and state estimation for robot autonomy in challenging real-world environments. My recent research spans localization, mapping, and 3D perception for mobile robots deployed in the wild. My research mainly focuses on robust localization and spatial 3D perception in perceptually degraded environments using optimization and data driven methods. My solutions have been employed in real-world robotics deployments in forests, volcanic terrain, lava caves, mountain ranges and other harsh environments. Specifically, I develop degeneracy-aware LiDAR registration and multi-modal state-estimation frameworks, with a strong focus on localizability, observability, and failure-aware optimization under real-world conditions. My recent publications further explore challenges in real-world robotics through advanced perception payload design and legged-robot specific dataset collections. Additionally, I am increasing the scope of my focus to efficient, incrementally updated, and context-aware spatial 3D representations, including both implicit and explicit scene representations for consistent local and global scene understanding. For more information, please refer to my Curriculum Vitae . Research Focus Robust Localization and Mapping Real-time 3D Perception on Edge Compute Spatial 3D scene Representations Multi-modal Sensor Fusion Education MSc in Robotics, Systems and Control ETH Zurich BSc in Control and Automation Engineering Istanbul Technical University BSc in Mechanical Engineering Istanbul Technical University

content: ALMA is equipped with a robotic arm designed for articulated locomotion and manipulation.

title: ANYmal C
summary: ANYmal is optimized for automated industrial inspection tasks with a wide range of sensors.
content: ANYmal is optimized for automated industrial inspection tasks with a wide range of sensors.

title: SuperMegaBot
summary: SuperMegaBot is a 4-wheeled mobile robot for autonomous site inspection and artifact detection.
content: SuperMegaBot is a 4-wheeled mobile robot for autonomous site inspection and artifact detection.

title: GrandTour: A legged robotics dataset in the wild for multi-modal perception and state estimation
summary: Multimodal ANYmal-D field dataset combining the Boxi payload, robot proprioception and surveyed ground truth for perception and state-estimation research.
content: Multimodal ANYmal-D field dataset combining the Boxi payload, robot proprioception and surveyed ground truth for perception and state-estimation research.

title: TRaIL-Odom: Tightly Coupled Continuous Time Radar-IMU-LiDAR Odometry With Adaptive Doppler Weighting
summary: Radar–IMU–LiDAR odometry adjusts individual Doppler constraints and overall radar weight according to weakly constrained LiDAR directions. Evaluated on 13 sequences.
content: Radar–IMU–LiDAR odometry adjusts individual Doppler constraints and overall radar weight according to weakly constrained LiDAR directions. Evaluated on 13 sequences.

title: BIEVR-LIO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry through Bump-Image-Enhanced Voxel Maps
summary: LiDAR-inertial odometry uses oriented height images inside voxels and map-informed sampling to exploit small geometric variations in difficult scenes.
content: LiDAR-inertial odometry uses oriented height images inside voxels and map-informed sampling to exploit small geometric variations in difficult scenes.

title: Holistic Fusion: Task- and Setup-Agnostic Robot Localization and State Estimation With Factor Graphs
summary: Factor-graph formulation jointly estimates local/global robot states and evolving reference-frame alignments so heterogeneous sensors can be fused across setups.
content: Factor-graph formulation jointly estimates local/global robot states and evolving reference-frame alignments so heterogeneous sensors can be fused across setups.

title: CaRLi-V: Camera–RADAR–LiDAR Point-Wise 3-D Velocity Estimation
summary: Combines radar radial velocities, optical flow and LiDAR ranges to estimate point-wise three-dimensional velocity using a closed-form fusion step.
content: Combines radar radial velocities, optical flow and LiDAR ranges to estimate point-wise three-dimensional velocity using a closed-form fusion step.

title: One-Shot Badminton Shuttle Detection for Mobile Robots
summary: Mobile-viewpoint shuttlecock detection with a 20,510-frame, 11-background dataset, semi-automatic annotation and a fine-tuned YOLOv8 detector.
content: Mobile-viewpoint shuttlecock detection with a 20,510-frame, 11-background dataset, semi-automatic annotation and a fine-tuned YOLOv8 detector.

title: Large-Scale Autonomous Gas Monitoring for Volcanic Environments: A Legged Robot on Mount Etna
summary: ANYmal carries a quadrupole mass spectrometer for volcanic gas monitoring. Three autonomous Etna missions report 93–100% autonomy; a separate teleoperated mission sampled natural fumaroles.
content: ANYmal carries a quadrupole mass spectrometer for volcanic gas monitoring. Three autonomous Etna missions report 93–100% autonomy; a separate teleoperated mission sampled natural fumaroles.

title: Informed, Constrained, Aligned: A Field Analysis on Degeneracy-Aware Point Cloud Registration in the Wild
summary: Analyzes and experimentally compares active/passive degeneracy handling, truncated SVD, inequality constraints and Tikhonov regularization for point-cloud registration.
content: Analyzes and experimentally compares active/passive degeneracy handling, truncated SVD, inequality constraints and Tikhonov regularization for point-cloud registration.

title: Continuous-Time State Estimation Methods in Robotics: A Survey
summary: Unifies and reviews continuous-time estimation using splines and Gaussian processes, relating formulations, applications and open research problems.
content: Unifies and reviews continuous-time estimation using splines and Gaussian processes, relating formulations, applications and open research problems.

title: Boxi: Design Decisions in the Context of Algorithmic Performance for Robotics
summary: Open sensor-payload design connects synchronization, calibration, hardware layout, power and thermal choices to downstream localization and mapping performance.
content: Open sensor-payload design connects synchronization, calibration, hardware layout, power and thermal choices to downstream localization and mapping performance.

title: ForestLPR: LiDAR Place Recognition in Forests Attentioning Multiple BEV Density Images
summary: Uses horizontal slices of LiDAR geometry, bird’s-eye-view density images and attention to recognize revisited places in forests.
content: Uses horizontal slices of LiDAR geometry, bird’s-eye-view density images and attention to recognize revisited places in forests.

title: Diffusion Based Robust LiDAR Place Recognition
summary: Diffusion model trained from synthetic LiDAR views of building meshes produces multiple global-position hypotheses in repetitive construction environments.
content: Diffusion model trained from synthetic LiDAR views of building meshes produces multiple global-position hypotheses in repetitive construction environments.

title: LEVA: A High-Mobility Logistic Vehicle with Legged Suspension
summary: Logistics robot combines steerable wheels, legged suspension and autonomous box loading for transporting payloads up to 85 kg over uneven terrain.
content: Logistics robot combines steerable wheels, legged suspension and autonomous box loading for transporting payloads up to 85 kg over uneven terrain.

title: X-ICP: Localizability-Aware LiDAR Registration for Robust Localization in Extreme Environments
summary: Detects localizability along optimization directions and uses that information to constrain ICP updates in geometrically uninformative environments.
content: Detects localizability along optimization directions and uses that information to constrain ICP updates in geometrically uninformative environments.

title: Global Path Planning for Autonomous Vehicles in Orchards and Vineyards
summary: Global-path-planning research for autonomous operations among structured orchard and vineyard rows.
content: Global-path-planning research for autonomous operations among structured orchard and vineyard rows.

title: Autonomous Forest Inventory with Legged Robots: System Design and Field Deployment
summary: Integrates state estimation, navigation and tree measurement on a legged robot. A Forest of Dean deployment surveyed 0.96 ha in 20 minutes and identified over 100 trees.
content: Integrates state estimation, navigation and tree measurement on a legged robot. A Forest of Dean deployment surveyed 0.96 ha in 20 minutes and identified over 100 trees.

title: Scientific exploration of challenging planetary analog environments with a team of legged robots
summary: A team of legged robots combines locomotion, mapping, target perception and scientific instruments for exploration of difficult planetary-analog terrain.
content: A team of legged robots combines locomotion, mapping, target perception and scientific instruments for exploration of difficult planetary-analog terrain.

title: Deep learning frameworks to learn prediction and simulation focused control system models
summary: Studies prediction-focused and simulation-focused deep models for nonlinear system identification, including autoencoder and recurrent-network designs.
content: Studies prediction-focused and simulation-focused deep models for nonlinear system identification, including autoencoder and recurrent-network designs.

title: Design and development of FOLLY: A self-foldable and self-deployable quadcopter
summary: Develops the mechanics and design of a quadcopter that folds and deploys its arms automatically, extending the earlier FOLLY conference work.
content: Develops the mechanics and design of a quadcopter that folds and deploys its arms automatically, extending the earlier FOLLY conference work.

title: FOLLY: A Self Foldable and Self Deployable Autonomous Quadcopter
summary: Introduces a self-folding, self-deploying quadcopter using a crank-slider mechanism and gearing for compact transport and autonomous deployment.
content: Introduces a self-folding, self-deploying quadcopter using a crank-slider mechanism and gearing for compact transport and autonomous deployment.

title: Correction to: Deep learning frameworks to learn prediction and simulation focused control system models
summary: Adds the funding acknowledgement for TUBITAK project 118E807 to the original deep-learning article.
content: Adds the funding acknowledgement for TUBITAK project 118E807 to the original deep-learning article.
